Sky-Watcher Star Adventurer 2i

Turn any camera into a deep-sky rig.

around $430

A portable star tracker that rotates your camera with the Earth, turning 30-second exposures into 3-minute ones. This is the piece of gear that takes a skywatch photo from 'blurry dot' to 'that's clearly structured'.
